title: WHEN THE WAY AHEAD
IS UNCERTAIN
end: The Guided Path — seek God's wisdom for every step
stock_queries: misty alpine trail at dawn quiet wilderness
calm mountain lake early morning light
foggy pine forest trail morning sunbeams
peaceful river winding through mountain valley
serene mountain ridge sunrise soft glow
still waters in misty alpine valley
quiet mountain path leading into golden morning

scenes.a: You cannot see where this path turns.
Scripture reminds us in Proverbs twenty, verse twenty-four:
Man’s goings are of the LORD; how can a man then understand his own way?
scenes.sub: MAN'S GOINGS ARE OF THE LORD

scenes.a: Heavenly Father, when our steps feel confused and our own plans make no sense, we yield our understanding to You.
We admit that we cannot chart our own future or force our own outcomes.
Order our steps according to Your purpose, and quiet our restless need to figure out every detail.
Lead us through every uncertain hour into Your quiet peace. Amen. Teach us to trust, even when you cannot see where this path turns.
